steps.en: The latest email address of the company owner is obtained
steps.id: Alamat email terbaru pemilik perusahaan didapat
steps.why_en: The latest-contact lookup is switched off, so only stored contacts are used.
steps.why_id: Pengecekan kontak terbaru dimatikan, jadi hanya kontak tersimpan yang dipakai.

steps.en: Unique company owners are identified and their open notices combined
steps.id: Pemilik perusahaan unik diidentifikasi dan notice terbukanya digabung
steps.why_en: Notices with different due dates still produce separate messages for the same owner.
steps.why_id: Notice dengan tanggal jatuh tempo berbeda tetap jadi pesan terpisah untuk pemilik yang sama.

steps.en: Opted-out or no-email companies get no email
steps.id: Perusahaan opt-out atau tanpa email tidak dikirimi email

steps.en: The email lists the open notices and refers to the 2nd letter
steps.id: Email memuat notice yang masih terbuka dan merujuk surat kedua
steps.why_en: The message wording is held outside the code, so it cannot be confirmed here.
steps.why_id: Isi pesan disimpan di luar code, jadi tidak bisa dipastikan di sini.

steps.en: The email is sent to the company owner in a batch job
steps.id: Email dikirim ke pemilik perusahaan lewat batch job
steps.why_en: The reminder job and email sending are both switched off in production.
steps.why_id: Job reminder dan pengiriman email sama-sama dimatikan di produksi.
